name: tiffin-service-monorepo
description: Tiffin Service Fullstack Application - React + Vite Frontend & Node.js + Express Backend

scripts.build: npm run install:deps && npm run build:compile
scripts.install:deps: npm ci && cd server && npm ci && cd ../client && npm ci && cd ..
scripts.build:compile: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.build:prod: npm run prebuild && npm run build && npm run install:prod
scripts.install:prod: cd server && npm ci --omit=dev && cd ../client && npm ci --omit=dev && cd ..
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.install:all:prod: npm ci --omit=dev && cd client && npm ci --omit=dev && cd ../server && npm ci --omit=dev
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:server && npm run lint:fix:client
scripts.format:client: cd client && npm run format || echo 'Format script not configured in client'
scripts.test:client: cd client && npm run test || echo 'Tests not configured in client'
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:server && npm run type-check:client
scripts.clean: npm run clean:deps && npm run clean:builds
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rimraf package-lock.json client/package-lock.json server/package-lock.json
scripts.reset: npm run clean:all && npm run install:all
scripts.fresh: npm run clean:all && npm install && npm run install:all && npm run dev
scripts.postinstall:
echo '
✅ Root dependencies installed!
💡 Run: npm run install:all (to install client & server deps)
🚀 Then: npm run dev (to start development)
'
